Definition: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
BiblicalUsage: 1) a team, chariot, chariotry, mill-stone, riders; 1a) chariotry, chariots; 1b) chariot (single); 1c) upper millstone (as riding on lower millstone); 1d) riders, troop (of riders), horsemen, pair of horsemen, men riding, ass-riders, camel-riders
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
